title: Affine etale cover by a disjoint union of affines
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Write $|E|$ for the set of field-valued point classes of $E$: maps $\operatorname{Spec}K\to E$ with $K$ a field [def-weil-field], two such maps being identified when they agree after restriction to a common field extension; a morphism $t:h_T\to E$ from a scheme $T$ induces $|t|:|T|\to|E|$, sending a point $x$ to the class of $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to T\to E$. There exist a scheme $W$ that is a disjoint union of affine schemes and a representable surjective etale morphism $w:h_W\to E$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] such that $|w|:|W|\to|E|$ is surjective. The affine components may be chosen so that each maps into an affine open subscheme of $S$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Give $|E|$ the quotient topology of $|w|$; it does not depend on the choice of the representable surjective etale map $w$ from a scheme. With this topology, for every scheme $T$ and every morphism $t:h_T\to E$ the map $|t|:|T|\to|E|$ is continuous, and if $t$ is representable etale, then $|t|$ is open; in particular its image is open in $|E|$.

proof.text: Choose a representable surjective etale atlas $p:h_V\to E$ by [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Apply the affine-refinement clause of [lem-a1-space-atlas-open-refinement-pullback] to obtain an open cover $(U_i)$ of $V$ by affines with factorizations through affine opens of $S$. Form $W=\coprod_iU_i$ by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Its coproduct property gives $r:W\to V$ and $w=p\circ h_r$; the displayed affine components retain their factorizations through the affine base opens.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-space-atlas-open-refinement-pullback] to this specific covering $(U_i)$ of $V$. It gives representable surjective etaleness of $w$ and surjectivity of $|w|$, together with the scheme-test coproduct description. Thus $W$, with the affine components and affine-base factorizations constructed in step 1, has all the required covering properties, including the empty case.

proof.text: Define a topology on $|E|$ by declaring $A$ open exactly when $|w|^{-1}(A)$ is open; inverse images preserve unions and finite intersections, so this is a topology. For any other representable surjective etale scheme atlas $p:h_V\to E$, [lem-a1-space-atlas-point-comparison] says exactly that $|w|^{-1}(A)$ is open if and only if $|p|^{-1}(A)$ is open. Hence the two quotient topologies coincide.

source.place: Tag 03BX (lemma-topology-points), proof: comparison of presentations through their fibre product; Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), the common-field point-lifting argument.

proof.text: For any $t:h_T\to E$ and any open $A\subseteq|E|$, its inverse image in $W$ is open by definition. The inverse-image assertion of [lem-a1-space-atlas-test-open-subsets] makes $|t|^{-1}(A)$ open in $T$. This proves continuity. If $t$ is representable etale and $B\subseteq|T|$ is open, the same lemma makes $|w|^{-1}(|t|(B))$ open in $W$; the quotient definition therefore makes $|t|(B)$ open in $|E|$. Taking $B=|T|$ gives the open-image assertion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_etale_cover_and_point_topology {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : AlgebraicSpace S) : ∃ (W : Over S) (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ E.obj.obj) (I : Type u) (A : I → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ i : I, A i ⟶ W.left), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk W.left ι)) ∧ (∀ i : I, IsAffine (A i)) ∧ (∀ i : I, ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (a : A i ⟶ U.toScheme), a ≫ U.ι = ι i ≫ W.hom) ∧ IsRepresentable w ∧ IsSurjective w ∧ IsEtale w ∧ Function.Surjective (schemePointMap w) ∧ ∃ τ : TopologicalSpace (Point E.obj.obj), τ = TopologicalSpace.coinduced (schemePointMap w) inferInstance ∧ (∀ (V : Over S) (p : yoneda.obj V ⟶ E.obj.obj), IsRepresentable p → IsSurjective p → IsEtale p → τ = TopologicalSpace.coinduced (schemePointMap p) inferInstance) ∧ (∀ (T : Over S) (t : yoneda.obj T ⟶ E.obj.obj), @Continuous T.left (Point E.obj.obj) inferInstance τ (schemePointMap t) ∧ (IsEtale t → @IsOpenMap T.left (Point E.obj.obj) inferInstance τ (schemePointMap t) ∧ @IsOpen (Point E.obj.obj) τ (Set.range (schemePointMap t))))
